---
name: New target
about: Ask for (or offer to build) support for another time or expense system
title: "Target: <system name>"
labels: new target
---

**System**
Name, website, and who typically uses it (e.g. "client's time tool", "staffing partner portal").

**API**
Link to the API documentation. How does it authenticate (password, token, OAuth)?

**What should be replicated**
- [ ] Time
- [ ] Expenses
- [ ] Receipt files

**Does the system lock or report per month?**

**Can a row carry a free-text comment or an external reference?**
(time-assistant tags each row it writes so re-runs never duplicate.)

**Will you build it?**
- [ ] Yes, following docs/adding-a-target.md
- [ ] I can test against a real account
- [ ] I'm asking for someone else to build it

Please don't paste real ids, names, comments or credentials.
